# Utah High School Football

> Independent power ratings, scores, stats, playoff brackets and recruiting profiles for all 106 Utah 11-man high school football programs (6A through 1A). Free, and not affiliated with any school, district or the UHSAA. Nothing here is for betting.

Every program is rated on one scale (the Ledger Rating), so a 2A team and a 6A team can be compared directly. Ratings come from a weighted regression on capped, garbage-time-adjusted scoring margin, with a preseason prior that fades as games accumulate. Pages are rebuilt several times a day during the season.

Sourcing: final scores and home/away follow the Deseret News, with conflicts resolved at the box score; player and team statistics come mainly from MaxPreps box scores; playoff brackets and the official RPI come from the UHSAA. Every number on the site traces to a source; when there's no source, the field is left blank. Corrections are made the same day.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://utahhighschoolfootball.com/): scores, playoffs, rankings, stats and recruiting in one app
- [Rankings: all 106 teams](https://utahhighschoolfootball.com/utah-high-school-football-rankings): the full statewide power ranking with record and rating
- [All 106 teams](https://utahhighschoolfootball.com/utah-high-school-football-teams): directory of every 11-man program
- [State champions](https://utahhighschoolfootball.com/utah-high-school-football-state-champions): every state champion since 1898

## School pages

One page per program at https://utahhighschoolfootball.com/<school>-football (for example [Alta](https://utahhighschoolfootball.com/alta-football)): the season record, rating and statewide and class rank, schedule and results, team leaders, region standings, coaching staff and program records.

## Rivalry pages

80 rivalry pages at https://utahhighschoolfootball.com/<team-a>-<team-b>-rivalry, each with the series history and recent results.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://utahhighschoolfootball.com/sitemap.xml): every page, with its last-changed date
- [X: @TheLedgerUT](https://x.com/TheLedgerUT)
